descriptionHtml: The workshop will be an one day event and it is consists of an introductory session followed by a lecture series at which the undergraduates will be given a thorough idea on wiring regulations in the morning and after the lunch participants will be divided into groups and they will be given a specific design to complete. Finally there will be Q and A session where all participants can clarify their unclear areas on wiring.
venue: faculty seminar room 3, 3, University of peradeniya
